listing.name: Fair S Mods
listing.summary: This mod is meant to make building in cheaper hullmods viable. For example, if you build in an "Advanced Turret Gyros" on a capital which originally costs 10 OP, the difference is 20 OP, so you get 20 OP * 75% = 15 OP added to your hull.
listing.aiSummary: Makes built-in hull mods cheaper by adding OP to the hull based on a percentage of the original cost difference.

Requires CONCORD 3.5 or above version

This mod is meant to make building in cheaper hullmods viable.
For example, if you build in an "Advanced Turret Gyros" on a capital which originally costs 10 OP, the difference is 20 OP, so you get 20 OP * 75% = 15 OP added to your hull.

Using Better Deserved S Mods or Progressive S Mods reduce the effectiveness to 25%; Using both nullifies the mod.
The ratios and base bonus multipliers are adjustable in settings file (data/config/settings.json)

The mod can be added mid-game and is automatically applied.
The mod is currently SAFE TO REMOVE after CONCORD 3.5.2a

aiDescription: Adjusts the cost of built-in hull mods to make them more viable. For example, a hull mod costing 10 OP with a 20 OP difference results in 15 OP added to the hull. The effectiveness is reduced when used alongside Better Deserved S Mods or Progressive S Mods, and nullified if both are present. Ratios and multipliers are adjustable in the settings file.
